Best for

  • Hospitals, malls and large commercial buildings
  • Industrial plants and process cooling
  • Central plants serving many air-handling units

How to choose

  • Air-cooled screw chillers need no cooling tower and suit sites with limited water.
  • Water-cooled chillers are more efficient at large scale but need a cooling tower and water supply.
  • Centrifugal chillers suit the largest loads, from 300 to 1100 TR.

Air-cooled or water-cooled chiller: which is right?

Air-cooled chillers are simpler to install and need no cooling tower, which helps where water is scarce. Water-cooled chillers are more efficient for very large loads but need a cooling tower. We advise based on your load and site.

What capacities are available?

Hitachi air-cooled screw chillers range from 45 to 450 TR, and direct drive centrifugal chillers from 300 to 1100 TR. Water-cooled screw chillers are also available.
